edges.reason: Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender, making the caller the initial privileged account
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before staging a new owner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership
onlyOwner modifier gates the arbitrary ERC20 sweep on msg.sender
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits the sender in the Transfer event
approve stores allowed[msg.sender][spender], keying the allowance on the caller
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller controls which allowance is spent
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external call
